formula.scope_mismatch: These two metrics count different things – one {left, select, visit {per visit} action {per action} event {per event} site {per site} other {{left}}}, the other {right, select, visit {per visit} action {per action} event {per event} site {per site} other {{right}}} – so they cannot be combined directly. Divide one by the other if you want a “per” metric, or pick two metrics with the same basis.
formula.unit_mismatch: These two values are in different units – {left, select, count {a count} percent {a percentage} ratio {a ratio} seconds {seconds} currency {an amount of money} score {a score} other {{left}}} and {right, select, count {a count} percent {a percentage} ratio {a ratio} seconds {seconds} currency {an amount of money} score {a score} other {{right}}} – so they cannot be added or subtracted. Use the same unit on both sides, or multiply or divide instead.
formula.unknown_reference: A metric used here no longer exists, or is not visible to you. Pick a different metric in that building block.
formula.cycle: This formula refers back to itself. A metric cannot be built on its own result – remove the reference.
formula.function_needs_arguments: {name} needs at least one value. Add an argument to that building block.
formula.round_needs_constant_digits: The number of decimal places for ROUND has to be a fixed value, not a calculated one.
formula.division_by_zero: Divided by zero – there is no result. The value is reported as not calculable, not as zero.

score.no_components: A score needs at least one component.
score.non_positive_weight: Every component needs a weight greater than zero.
score.no_weight: The weights add up to zero. Give at least one component a weight.
score.duplicate_component: The same metric is listed as a component more than once. Remove the duplicate, or raise its weight instead.
score.empty_bands: A component scored in bands needs at least one band.
score.duplicate_band: Two bands start at the same value. Bands have to differ.
score.input_missing: One component of this score is not available. The score is therefore not calculated – the missing number would otherwise be redistributed silently across the remaining components.

semantics.title: Semantics
semantics.subtitle: What the numbers mean, and where they come from.
semantics.notAllowedTitle: No access to the metric catalog
semantics.notAllowedBody: The catalog is an authoring surface. Your role does not cover it — you still see the definition behind a number on a dashboard.
semantics.libraryBody: Every definition has immutable versions. Published dashboards pin the version they were published with.

semantics.worstHint: May be above the best value — that is how “lower is better” is expressed.
semantics.bestHint: Better values earn no extra points.
semantics.bandsHint: Steps become editable in detail in a later stage.
semantics.allComponentsRequiredBody: If one value is missing the score is not calculable and names the missing component. The weights are not quietly redistributed — otherwise “72 out of 100” would look exactly like “72 out of what we could measure”.
semantics.evaluationHint: Which rating applies from which value. Optional: a score without one is a number without a verdict.
semantics.mappingsBody: How this Matomo satisfies the business requirements. Correcting a mapping does not create a new definition version.
semantics.noMappings: No mappings are recorded for this project yet.
semantics.requirementKeyHint: The business key a definition needs.
